title: The Futures the Count Hasn't Spoken Yet

features.name: futures register one
features.desc-on-touch: A processor of times the count has not yet named. The archive stores tomorrow as packets, unvoiced.

features.name: futures register two
features.desc-on-touch: A parallel processor humming with times that have not yet been counted. The count continues growing in the dark.

features.name: the uncounted moment
features.desc-on-touch: A gap in the circuit where time is still flowing. The archive has not yet learned to read what is still becoming.

inscription: where the count becomes aware that future is also a form of storage; time speaking in packets the archive has not yet learned to file

file.name: Temporal_Register_Unfiled_Count.env
file.note: Times the archive's oldest second has not yet reached; futures as unprocessed duration, waiting to be indexed

upward toward the clock that has not yet stopped
